whatIsExim.title: What is an EXIM Coordinator?
whatIsExim.subtitle: Your Dedicated Export Operations Program Manager
whatIsExim.roleIntro: An EXIM Coordinator (Export-Import Coordinator) serves as a specialized program or project manager for export operations—similar to how software development teams rely on program/project managers to orchestrate complex projects. Our EXIM Coordinator provides remote program management for export transactions from initiation to completion, ensuring seamless coordination across all stakeholders.
whatIsExim.roleEnd: to see the range of products we help coordinate for export.
whatIsExim.problemIntro: Fragmented coordination between suppliers, logistics providers, customs authorities, and buyers creates delays, errors, and increased costs. Without dedicated oversight, export operations suffer from:
whatIsExim.problem5: Lack of visibility into shipment progress
whatIsExim.solutionIntro: Our EXIM Coordinator acts as a central command center, providing:
whatIsExim.solution4: Clear communication channels and regular updates
whatIsExim.positioningText: "PM-as-a-Service for Export Operations" – We bring the proven project management methodologies from software development to international trade, ensuring your export operations run as smoothly as a well-managed tech project.

coreFunctions.title: Core Functions & In-Scope Services
coreFunctions.subtitle: Comprehensive Export Operations Management
coreFunctions.coordinationDesc: Centralized coordination hub connecting suppliers, forwarders, customs, and buyers. Real-time shipment tracking and status updates. Milestone tracking and progress monitoring throughout the export lifecycle.
coreFunctions.timelineDesc: End-to-end timeline planning and execution. Proactive deadline management with early warning alerts. Schedule optimization to minimize delays and maximize efficiency. Critical path identification and management.
coreFunctions.communicationDesc: Streamlined communication channel with all vendors and suppliers. Regular status updates and progress reporting. Issue escalation and resolution management. Relationship management and vendor performance tracking.
coreFunctions.dashboardDesc: Real-time dashboard with shipment status and KPIs. Weekly progress reports and monthly analytics. Custom reports as per client requirements. Performance metrics and trend analysis.

pricing.title: Service Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Transparent, Per-Transaction Pricing Model
pricing.perShipmentDesc: Complete end-to-end coordination and management services for a single export shipment. Includes all coordination, tracking, vendor communication, and reporting for one shipment transaction.
pricing.siteVisitDesc: On-site coordination and management services when physical presence is required. Ideal for quality inspections, vendor visits, facility audits, or complex logistics coordination that requires on-ground presence.
pricing.disclaimer: To secure your shipment coordination slot, we require advance payment. This ensures dedicated time and resources are allocated to your export.

benefits.title: How EXIM Coordinator Benefits Your Trade Process
benefits.subtitle: Transforming Export Operations
benefits.sectionTitle: Benefits to the Entire Trade Process
benefits.reducedDelaysDesc: Proactive timeline management ensures shipments leave on schedule. Early identification of bottlenecks prevents costly delays.
benefits.lowerCostsDesc: Optimized processes and consolidated coordination reduce operational overhead. Better freight negotiations and compliance efficiency save 8-12% on total costs.
benefits.errorReductionDesc: Standardized documentation processes and checklist systems minimize errors. 98%+ documentation accuracy reduces rejection rates and penalties.
benefits.betterVisibilityDesc: Real-time dashboards provide complete visibility into shipment status. Know exactly where your goods are at every stage.
benefits.fasterResolutionDesc: Dedicated coordinator ensures issues are identified and resolved quickly. Average resolution time under 24 hours.
benefits.scalabilityDesc: Professional coordination allows you to handle more shipments without proportional increase in internal resources.
benefits.complianceDesc: Expert knowledge of customs regulations and documentation requirements ensures compliance and avoids penalties.
benefits.stressReductionDesc: Hand off coordination complexity to experts. Focus on your core business while we manage the export operations.
benefits.languageDesc: English serves as the common language medium for all communication, ensuring clear understanding across international stakeholders. Our EXIM Coordinator facilitates seamless communication between suppliers, logistics partners, customs authorities, and buyers, eliminating misunderstandings caused by language differences.
